glossary.definition: (D) As used in this section, "occupied structure" has the same meaning as in section 2909.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2923.161 - Improperly discharging firearm at or into a habitation, in a school safety zone or with intent to cause harm or panic to persons in a school building or at a school function.
